responsibility: Contains the writer-side runtime for serializing GIMPLE, trees, declarations, locations, and auxiliary target data into LTO bytecode streams. It creates and destroys output_block objects with main/cfg/string streams and tree caches, decides which trees are indexable or must stay local, emits location information, writes mode tables for offload compatibility, and finishes the decls section by streaming global and per-function declaration states, symbol tables, and recorded command-line options. This file is the main producer of structured LTO bytecode once higher-level passes have decided what program state to emit.
